literal: Those who have the habit of proclaiming even the faults of those who are close, what indeed will they do towards strangers?
translation: What indeed will those who make a habit of broadcasting even the faults of their close friends do when it comes to strangers?
modern: நெருங்கிய நண்பர்களின் குற்றங்களையும் பிறரிடம் தூற்றிப் பேசும் இயல்புடையவர்கள், தமக்குத் தொடர்பில்லாத அந்நியர்களிடம் என்னதான் செய்யமாட்டார்கள்?
explanation: This couplet exposes the character of those who indulge in backbiting. If a person has the habit of broadcasting the faults of their own close associates ('துன்னியார்'), they will certainly not hesitate to slander strangers ('ஏதிலார்'). The rhetorical question 'what indeed will they do' ('என்னை கொல்') emphasizes that their capacity for malice towards outsiders is boundless. The word 'தூற்றும்' literally means to scatter or winnow, vividly illustrating how gossip-mongers spread the secrets of others far and wide.
